evidence.honesty: Sample labelled 'This is a made-up alert at a made-up bank' directly above the case file, and footer repeats it; the label is not inside the case file, so at 390 it scrolls out of view while stepping. evidence.interaction: 1440: Next x4 reaches step 5 (status Open->Closed, 'Step 5 of 5'), Next becomes 'Start over' and returns to step 1; 20 rapid clicks end in a correct state; step buttons jump directly; ArrowLeft/Right work anywhere in the case file; Copy address shows 'Copied.' with a fallback message on failure; no console/page errors. evidence.proof: The stepper sits in the first screen at 1440 and is operable; status/owner/next action change per step (Open -> Assigned -> In review -> Awaiting approval -> Decided). evidence.craft: Single 46 KB HTML with a full token set (colours, spacing scale --s-1..9, fluid type scale), system fonts, no network requests (og:image points to the placeholder casefold.example domain). axe: only one minor issue (role=tabpanel on <article>); no contrast failures. A few inline style attributes; the sample case has no heading element (its title is a span) and the case sections use div labels rather than headings. Zoom 200% (720x450): no overflow, no clipped text.
evidence.mobile: 390: no overflow (also 320 and after expanding all Show rows); Menu button 67x44 opens a 48px-row list, Escape closes it and returns focus, tapping 'For the board' closes it and lands on #board; step tabs 62x44 (number + check only, name in the note). CTA explains email, hand setup and sample-only data before the click. Constraints sit inside the board brief rather than a separate apology list. evidence.interaction: Full tab pattern: roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down, Home, End all verified; Back/Next and direct tab clicks work; step 5 folds sections into summary rows with 4 'Show' toggles (aria-expanded updates, label flips to Hide); aria-live status note announces each step; Escape closes the menu; with JS off all five sections render and the stepper hides. No console/page errors. Defects: at step 5 Next becomes disabled 'Last step' and keyboard focus drops to BODY (same at Back on step 1); no explicit start-over.
evidence.copy: Customer-world language throughout ('Refer for a SAR decision', 'teller 14', 'I am not satisfied this is ordinary business', 'Approve, or send back to the reviewer'); headings carry information ('It starts after your monitoring system raises the alert, and stops before the SAR is filed.'). Minor: 'Last step' as a disabled button label, 'no card and no call needed' reads like consumer SaaS boilerplate.
evidence.first_screen: 1440x900: H1, lede, 'Request a sandbox' + email explanation and the operable labelled case file (alert, deposits, $38,050) all in one viewport. 390x844: H1, lede, both CTAs and the email explanation visible; the case-file label 'Fictional customer, staff and amounts' and step numbers start at y=713, so the artifact is just entering view.

problems: Sample case contradicts itself at step 4: status 'Awaiting approval' while the record already shows 'Approved 2026-03-11 14:32'.
On phones, newly revealed record content appears below the fold after tapping 'Next step' and the 'Show' toggles at step 5 are only 28px tall.
Keyboard focus falls to BODY when Next disables at step 5 (and Back at step 1); sample section has no heading and role=tabpanel is on an <article>.

reason: B puts an operable, labelled case file in the first screen, implements a complete tab/menu keyboard pattern with a no-JS fallback, passes axe contrast, and gives the board a real path. A is cleanly built but hides its proof below the fold, drops mobile navigation, and has a contrast failure. I would change my mind if B's step-4 approval contradiction or its below-the-fold feedback on phones were judged worse than A's missing mobile nav and late artifact.
